meta.name: amp-usinagem-industrial
meta.description: Skill suprema do projeto tcc-erp-usinagem. Use em qualquer tarefa deste repositório, especialmente redesign visual, integração entre módulos, automações de fluxo, desktop nativo, build/release e validação final.

copy.tagline: 整合并自动化ERP系统的视觉、模块与构建流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在开发或维护一个ERP系统，需要统一管理视觉、模块和发布流程。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate and automate ERP system's visual, modules, and build process
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing or maintaining an ERP system and need to unify visual, modules, and release workflow.

howto.what: Claude 会按照工业控制中心的风格来设计和改进这个 ERP 系统，确保界面统一、流程连贯，并强化客户→报价→订单→财务的业务链条。
howto.when: 当你在 tcc-erp-usinagem 仓库中处理任何任务时，包括界面重设计、模块集成、流程自动化、桌面原生开发、构建/发布或最终验证。

say.text: 帮我重新设计客户管理页面，让它更像工业控制中心。
say.note: 触发视觉系统参考和产品方向规则。

say.text: 优化报价到订单的自动流转，减少手动操作。
say.note: 触发运营流程参考和自动化规则。

say.text: 检查当前代码是否符合质量门禁，准备发布新版本。
say.note: 触发质量门禁参考和发布流程。

howto.what_en: Claude will design and improve this ERP system in the style of an industrial command center, ensuring unified UI, coherent workflows, and strengthening the client→quote→order→finance chain.
howto.when_en: When working on any task in the tcc-erp-usinagem repository, including UI redesign, module integration, workflow automation, native desktop, build/release, or final validation.

say_en.text: Redesign the customer management page to look like an industrial command center.
say_en.note: Triggers visual system reference and product direction rules.

say_en.text: Optimize the automatic flow from quote to order to reduce manual steps.
say_en.note: Triggers operational flow reference and automation rules.

say_en.text: Check current code against quality gates and prepare a new release.
say_en.note: Triggers quality gates reference and release process.
